title: Huawei schedules launch event for September 2
description: Huawei will be holding its next product launch event on September 2 in Munich, Germany. The keynote features the “Chase the wild” tagline, and we’re expecting to see the latest crop of wearables from the brand. Huawei recently unveiled the Watch GT 7 series in China so it seems like the perfect time to bring the Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro to the global stage. Huawei has historically also introduced new wireless earbuds alongside its smartwatches, so we’ll have to wait and see if that will be the case this time.

title: Samsung will release 5 new foldables next year, claim insiders
description: The Galaxy Z Fold8 was such a success out of the gate that Samsung increased the production target for this year by 1 million units. And that’s not all – Samsung will launch two wide foldables next year, claim insiders who spoke to ETNews. This means that the Galaxy Z9 generation will have a total of five members. No, we didn’t miscount: 1) the wide Z Fold9, 2) a second wide foldable, 3) Z Fold9 Ultra, 4) Z Flip9 and 5) a new Galaxy Z TriFold. title: Honor Turbo 5G makes surprise appearance ahead of official launch
description: Back in May, Honor unveiled its Win Turbo phone with a massive 10,000mAh battery and a listing on AliExpress has revealed a new Turbo member. The Honor Turbo 5G is a familiar-looking device, sharing the same design as the X80 Pro Max but with different specs. Honor Turbo 5G Turbo 5G is equipped with a 6.79-inch AMOLED with 1,200 x 2,640px resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It also features an 8,560 mAh battery with 80W wired charging and IP69K ingress protection. The phone boots MagicOS 10 based on Android 16. There’s a Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 under the hood, which is paired with...

title: HMD 2760 Flip design and key specs leak, said to run Android 13 Go
description: HMD unveiled the 2660 Flip feature phone at MWC in March last year. The company now appears to be preparing its successor, the 2760 Flip, which is tipped to run Android. According to a new leak, the HMD 2760 Flip will run Icon OS 13, which is based on Android 13 Go. This would mark a big change from its predecessor, which ran KaiOS. It also means that users will have access to the Google Play Store. The 4G flip phone is tipped to feature a 2.8-inch main LCD display and a 1.77-inch outer screen. It is expected to be powered by the Unisoc T310 chipset, paired with 2GB of RAM and 32GB...

title: CUBOT Teases KINGKONG Dura, a Rugged Phone Built Around Swappable Battery Power
description: CUBOT is preparing to unveil the KINGKONG Dura, a rugged smartphone built around a practical replaceable-battery system designed to reduce charging downtime and keep users moving. Instead of connecting the phone to a charging cable and waiting, users can remove the depleted battery, install a fully charged spare, and quickly return to work, travel, or outdoor activities. It is a straightforward approach to mobile power created for people whose days cannot always pause for charging. title: Poco M8x to be powered by Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, key specs and pricing tipped
description: Poco recently began teasing the M8x 5G's launch in India. While the company has yet to reveal details about the upcoming phone, a teaser on Flipkart has confirmed the chipset powering the handset and its launch date. A tipster has also leaked several other key specs and pricing details. According to the Flipkart teaser, the Poco M8x will launch in India on August 21 and come equipped with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset. However, tipster Yogesh Brar claims the handset will instead feature MediaTek's Dimensity 6300 SoC. Brar also claims that the handset will sport a 6.9-inch LCD...

title: Tipster claims Xiaomi 18 Ultra cancelled, upcoming vivo and Oppo Ultras won't go global
description: The Xiaomi 18 Ultra, which was rumored to debut in December this year, has reportedly been cancelled. According to a new leak, Xiaomi will launch only three smartphones as part of its upcoming 18 series. In a post on X, tipster Kartikey Singh claims that Xiaomi will not launch an 18 Ultra this year. According to the tipster, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will instead sit at the top of the company's upcoming flagship lineup. However, this does not necessarily mean Xiaomi has abandoned the Ultra model altogether and we could see a Xiaomi 17 Ultra successor next year. The company is likely...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets now appear in Google Play Console's supported devices list
description: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets were recently spotted on Bluetooth SIG's website, as they were Bluetooth-certified. Now those same tablets have appeared in Google Play Console's supported devices list. The Galaxy Tab S12 series consists of two tablets - the Galaxy Tab S12+ and the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. The Google Play Console lists five models of the Galaxy Tab S12+ and three models of the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. title: Pixel 11 series, Honor Robot Phone, Redmi 17 official, Week 33 in review
description: Tech news started picking up a bit, especially in the past week. Google unveiled its Pixel 11 series alongside the Pixel Watch 5. The Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold all pack the new Tensor G6 SoC, which turned out to use a 3nm process after all, not the heavily rumored 2nm. The specs of the Pixel phones are mostly the same as their predecessors - the small Pro has a 6.3-inch display, the Pro XL a 6.8-inch one, but brighter. title: Weekly poll: which Google Pixel 11 model would you buy?
description: Google announced the new Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL and 11 Pro Fold this week – the phones are already available for pre-order and will be available from August 20. Are you planning on getting one? The company changed up the memory configuration structure for the 11-series. The 128GB models are now gone (and good riddance), but now the 256GB Pro and Pro XL have 12GB of RAM instead of 16GB. title: Samsung is likely preparing Sony and Apple headphones rival for next year
description: A few days ago, a reference to the Samsung Galaxy Buds On popped up online - buds with an ear-hook design, along with some illustrations showing what they would look like. Now, the same source shows off a potential Sony WH-1000XM6 and Apple AirPods Max 2 rival. Icons for the Galaxy H1 headphones Yes, Samsung is likely planning a return to the high-end over-ear headphones market after a long pause. title: Deals: the Google Pixel 11 series is now on pre-order with gift cards and trade-in bonuses
description: Google launched its new Pixel 11 series earlier this week – there is a new vanilla, two new Pro and one new foldable model. All that’s missing now is an affordable a-phone. The massive increase in RAM prices has affected the Pixel series. Google now offers 256GB storage as standard on all 11-series models, which is a good thing, but the Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL start with 12GB of RAM. If you want 16GB (which is what all Pixel 10 Pro and 10 Pro XL phones had), you will have to get a 512GB or a 1TB model. title: Weekly poll results: a surprising number of people are using feature phones
description: Feature phones are not as dead as you may have thought – one third of voters in last week’s poll use one at least occasionally. Some even use a feature phone full time as their only phone. And others are at least thinking about the idea of ditching their smartphone. As some commenters point out, smartphones are basically a necessity in some countries – you might need one for messaging family and clients, for bank authentication and so on. Even so, some manage to get by with a feature phone as their only handset. That said, a large portion of voters are never going back to feature phones...

title: iQOO 16 tipped to come with a higher refresh rate screen, new design
description: iQOO is said to launch the iQOO 16 in September, with the latest rumor from China claiming it will have a higher refresh-rate screen than its predecessor. The word comes from reliable tipster Digital Chat Station, who claimed the iQOO 16 will feature a 165Hz refresh rate screen. It will be a 6.85" flat 2K display sourced from Samsung. For comparison, last year's iQOO 15 came with a 6.85" flat display having a 144Hz refresh rate. title: iQOO Buds TWS earphones launching on August 20
description: iQOO will launch the Z11 in India on August 20, and on the same day, the brand will also unveil the iQOO Buds TWS earphones. The teaser posted by iQOO's Indian branch on X reveals the iQOO Buds' design. These are in-ear type and have silicone ear tips, which should offer passive noise cancellation. description: Google just dropped the Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 update to eligible Pixel devices, and in addition to squashing a few bugs, the new software introduces some cool new features as well. Quick Settings layout editor With Android 17, Google is adding a new Quick Settings layout editor that allows you to arrange pretty much all of the toggles and settings.
